title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E2 — Happy Birthday, Pop
Fred's 65th birthday is anything but happy when his first Social Security check and Lamont's 'night on the town' don't meet his expectations.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E3 — Here Comes The Bride There Goes The Bride
Fred's protest against Lamont's impending marriage fails to change his son's mind. But as the ceremony begins, the bride-to-be changes her mind, leaving Lamont standing at the altar and haggling with his relatives over their wedding gifts.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E4 — The Copper Caper
Fred's suspicions about a used-copper salesman are ignored by Lamont, especially after his son checks the metal's going price. But unfortunately for everyone, Fred's instincts prove to be correct. The copper Lamont bought was stolen.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E5 — A Matter Of Life And Breath
Lamont and Fred, at Lamont's insistence, take advantage of the free tests offered by a Breathmobile. The results convince Fred that he has tuberculosis.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E26 — Jenny's Thesis
Jenny Jefferson's thesis research on street gangs teaches her and her family a horrifying lesson in life...and death.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E1 — Louise's Painting
George riled by bare facts.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E2 — Homecoming-Part 1
Allan Willis, the 'white sheep' of the racially-mixed Willis family, arrives in town after several years absence and finds things just as he left them -- hostile -- in the first of a two-part story.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E3 — The Homecoming-Part 2
Allan sees through George's scheme to con him out of his newly inherited warehouse, so George directs his flim-flammery at an alternate target -- Louise -- in the conclusion of a two-part story.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E4 — How Slowly They Forget
George's unexpected offer to help Louise and Allan cut through the red tape that's delaying the move of the Help Center turns into more trouble than anyone is prepared to handle.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E5 — George's Dream
Obsessed with landing a crucial new cleaning account, an overwrought and exhausted George lapses into sleep and wakes up to a terrifying look at his future.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E6 — George's New Stockbroker
George is fascinated by a highly successful -- if unconventional -- stockbroker, until he finds out about his unusual medical past.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E20 — Barbara Feldon, Phil Silvers
Phil & Barbara are paired in three sketches as actors in a soup commercial, a dating couple & patrons at Charley's Diner.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E21 — Sandy Duncan, Slappy White, Jim Nabors
Slappy does stand-up; Flip, Nabors & Duncan do an airplane sketch and Flip’s invisible dog appears (or does he?).

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E22 — Barbara McNair, Stiller & Meara, Roy Clark
Roy & Barbara are selling door-to-door; Stiller & Meara do a women's lib skit and join Flip for a boxing sketch.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E23 — Joe Namath, George Carlin
Carlin does his 'Occupation: Foole' bit, hair poem and a newscast spoof with Flip; Geraldine ogles Namath.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E15 — Ruby Dee/Ossie Davis
Ruby Dee and Ossie Davis, aided by the music of composer-saxophonist Lucky Thompson, give dramatic readings of the poetry of a writer named Robert Cornell Kaufman.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E16 — Nick Ashford/Valerie Simpson
The songwriting/performing duo of Nick Ashford and Valerie Simpson appear in a concert of rock and gospel music on Soul!

title: Webster
description:
S3 E4 — Big Problems
Webster's friend Rob is upset because he feels that he is too tall.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E5 — One More Shot
George takes Webster to a New York Knicks game and introduces him to Patrick Ewing.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E6 — The Triangle
Webster takes a picture and shows it to Katherine, who then starts to think that a neighbor is having an affair.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E7 — Parent Trap
As a lesson in teaching Webster responsibility, George and Katherine switch roles to where they are the kids and Webster is the parent.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E8 — Alien
Webster's friend Rob picks up a tabloid and asks Webster some questions from it. Webster gets the questions right and according to the tabloid, Webster is an alien from Jupiter and he starts to believe it.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S1 E10 — Wedding Bells & Box Boys
Lisa blames Ray for leading a bridal client astray, while Tia and Tamera see Roger in a whole new light during a double date.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S1 E11 — Mothers and Other Strangers
When Lisa's disapproving mother comes for a visit, Ray agrees to pose as her husband.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S1 E12 — The Concert
After their parents forbid them to attend a rap concert, the twins sneak out of the house to meet their idol anyway.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S2 E1 — Hair Today
Tamera's glamorous new look gets her into a snobby clique -- but threatens her relationship with Tia, who's been snubbed by the same crowd.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S2 E2 — Get a Job
Bored with their jobs at Ray's limousine company, the twins secretly start working at a burger stand and quickly learn the perils of trying to be in two places at the same time.

title: Moesha
description:

Mo, Kim and Niecy play a game of “Truth or Dare”.
